The main takeaway from our work is that
helicity and rotation can play a crucial role in the dynamics of small-scale turbulence, with important consequences on the energy spectrum and the intermittency of the velocity field.
the helicity of the flow plays a significant role in determining the structure of turbulence, in particular in the small-scale regime.

helicity is not a passive quantity in turbulence and should be considered in any theory aiming at describing the small-scale dynamics of rotating turbulent flows, in particular those of geophysical and astrophysical interest.
